titleLogo.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: finished transparent title logo for the fantasy dungeon RPG "Four Lanterns Deep", to be used on its loading screen.
Primary request: create a much more beautiful, professional, memorable game logo than a simple geometric badge. Make a polished illustrated fantasy title treatment with an evocative emblem and excellent custom lettering.
Subject and composition: a weathered stone dungeon arch framing a descending stair that disappears into deep blue-green darkness. Exactly four distinct warm hanging lanterns, at varied heights and depths, illuminate the arch and stair. Integrate this compact emblem above and partly behind the wordmark. The lettering is the primary read; the silhouette must remain clear at a medium loading-screen size.
Text (verbatim): "FOUR LANTERNS" on the first line and "DEEP" below, DEEP large and commanding. No other text.
Style: premium hand-painted fantasy game branding, sculpted antique brass and pale warm stone lettering, elegant sturdy fantasy serif letterforms, subtle engraved detail and convincing depth, fine artistic finish. Adventurous, atmospheric, welcoming danger; visually compatible with charming stylized low-poly fantasy characters and a readable atmospheric dungeon. Beautiful bespoke design, not a corporate icon or generic flat vector seal.
Palette and lighting: rich restrained midnight teal, aged gold, warm amber lantern light and small ivory highlights. Four lantern flames provide the main luminous accents. Keep the type sharply legible with strong shape and understated ornament.
Constraints: transparent background, isolated complete logo with generous transparent margin, no rectangular backdrop, no scenery extending beyond the logo silhouette, no mockup, no watermark, no extra words, no skulls, no modern objects, no tiny unreadable ornamental clutter. Keep the four lanterns and their flame locations distinct so subtle light flicker and embers can be animated in code later. Do not include drifting sparks in the static artwork.

desktopIcon.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand.
Edit target: the attached approved Four Lanterns Deep title logo.
Create the matching square desktop app icon from this exact logo's illustrated dungeon-arch emblem. Preserve the beautiful weathered stone, restrained ivy, antique brass lanterns, warm amber light, teal darkness, and the SAME FOUR lanterns receding into the arched passage. Keep the artwork hand-painted and richly finished, visually identical in art direction to the approved title.
Remove ALL lettering, wordmark, bottom gold flourishes and title decoration. Recompose the arch, exactly four lanterns and short stair as a strong centered square app-icon silhouette that fills most of the canvas with a modest transparent margin. Simplify only tiny details that would disappear at small icon sizes. Actual transparent background outside the emblem, no square backplate, no text, no watermark, no extra lanterns. This is a companion icon to the approved logo, not a redesign of it.

animation: Runtime CSS flame glows and embers; generated alpha remains intact. Reduced-motion preference disables movement.
